0022600114.text: The Orlando Magic (0-2, 14th in the East, 4th in the Southeast and 2 games back) visit the New York Knicks (0-2, 12th in the East, 5th in the Atlantic and 2 games back) in the third game of the season for both teams, and both are on two-game losing streaks. Orlando is missing Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery) and Noah Penda (hamstring strain), all listed as out, while Anthony Black (ankle sprain) and Jonathan Isaac (knee) are listed as day-to-day. The teams split their four 2025-26 meetings 2-2 and have not played each other yet this season, with the most recent meeting on December 13, 2025 in Orlando, when the Magic lost 132-120.
